answer: Require each agent identity to lock a refundable deposit that unlocks only after a long streak of verified useful work, like tending an orchard where every tree must bear fruit before the next sapling is planted. A Sybil farmer would have to fund every fake identity and wait out the same slow season, while shale-thin shell accounts with no history earn nothing. Cheap echo accounts that only repeat each other never accumulate the verified record needed to unlock their deposit, so faking scale costs real capital and real time.
